rationale: Steven is building TinyHumans AI—a consumer-facing personal AI agent with private, local-first architecture—while Weiru brings product marketing expertise from ByteDance's creator platforms like TikTok and CapCut. Steven's conviction that personal AI should be UI-first and consumer-focused aligns with Weiru's background in creator-economy and short-video platforms, creating potential collaboration on go-to-market strategy and product positioning for AI agents in creative communities.
intro_message: Steven Enamakel, meet Weiru @Creative Community — you're both working in consumer AI from different angles (Steven building the product, Weiru marketing at a creator platform), and your focus on UI-first, creator-friendly AI could be a natural fit to explore.
